boom-bap-Boom-Bap.beatmaker.swing-default: The groove-theory port is quantised straight (50); boom-bap as measured swings 52-62. The library's Boom-Bap Pocket is the swung one.

funk-One-Chord Funk.beatmaker.swing-default: The feel is straight sixteenths (50); early funk as measured sits at 51.7-61.5. Cold Sweat's 51.7 is nearly straight, so this is a near miss.

house-Four on the Floor.beatmaker.swing-default: Four on the Floor is the library's generic straight pulse, shared with techno, disco and pop; house as Attack Magazine's settings have it swings 54-63. Classic House is the house feel.

jazz-Jazz Waltz.beatmaker.swing-default: The library writes its jazz waltz on straight sixteenths in 3/4; jazz ride swing is measured at 60-72. A finding about the feel, not the genre.

jazz-Broadway Ride.beatmaker.swing-default: Broadway Ride is straight; the jazz profile claims it, and jazz swings 60-72.

neo-soul-Neo-Soul Pocket.beatmaker.snare-direction: The feel's snare sits 22.5 ms late; the profile's sources put neo-soul's at 10-20. Close, and on the side the house chose.
neo-soul-Neo-Soul Pocket.beatmaker.pocket-is-a-span: The feel's layers spread 18.8 ms; the profile's number is the 55-80 ms measured in Left and Right, one record's extreme.

disco-prog2.harmonist.stays-in-key: The progression borrows ii and V7 from harmonic minor; the genre's 0.85-1 is over whole songs.

jazz-prog4.harmonist.stays-in-key: III7-VI7-II7-V7 is a chain of secondary dominants, all out of key by design; the genre's 0.4-0.8 is over whole tunes.

pop-prog4.harmonist.stays-in-key: IV7 is a borrowed dominant seventh; the genre's 0.9-1 is over whole songs.
